coaching.title: Medium 6 mi + 800 ft — B2B Day 2
coaching.message: Day 2 of the back-to-back. 6 miles, ~800 ft, first light at Red Rock. Your legs will feel heavy after yesterday's 18 — that heaviness IS the workout. Walk the first 3-5 minutes to loosen up, then settle into easy Zone 2 (HR 138-150, cap at 150 no matter what). Power-hike anything steep; there's zero benefit to forcing pace today. Learning to move well on pre-fatigued legs is exactly what the Julian Alps 50K back-half will demand.

coaching.title: Fuel Right
coaching.message: You depleted glycogen yesterday, so top off before you go: 40-60g easy carbs (banana, toast + honey) 30-45 min pre-run. It's short, but Red Rock heat is brutal — carry fluids and hit 700-900mg sodium/hr with salt pills (they're in your pack). Post-run within 30 min: 60-80g carbs + 25-30g protein to close out the back-to-back and rebuild for the week. Rehydrate aggressively in the desert heat.

coaching.title: Recovery
coaching.message: The B2B block is done after this — protect the adaptation. Get your legs elevated and 10-15 min of easy mobility/foam roll on quads and calves (they took the eccentric load from yesterday's descents). You've got the couples massage at Wynn this afternoon — perfect timing, let them work the legs. Prioritize sleep tonight; the heat + travel from Atlanta adds hidden fatigue.

coaching.title: Mental Edge
coaching.message: Five and a half weeks out — you're in the sharpest part of the build, and running strong on tired legs today is a confidence deposit you'll cash in Slovenia. When the Julian Alps course throws climbs at you in the final third, your body will remember mornings like this. Train the mind to stay calm and controlled when the legs complain. Steady effort, not heroics — that's the taper-ready athlete.
